tools.name: what_supports
tools.description: Edges recorded as SUPPORTING the given work or claim: human-signed support claims plus successful replication outcomes coded by the FORRT Replication Database. Use when a user asks whether a finding held up or was replicated.

tools.name: what_refutes
tools.description: Edges recorded as REFUTING the given work or claim: human-signed refutations plus failed replication outcomes coded by the FORRT Replication Database. Use when a user asks whether a finding failed to replicate or has been contradicted.

tools.name: what_cites
tools.description: Works that CITE the given DOI (incoming citations). Use when a user asks who cites a paper, how much a work has been cited, or whether a claimed 'cited by' is real. Returns edges with tier + attribution; paged.

tools.name: references_of
tools.description: What the given work CITES (its reference list). Use when a user asks what a paper relies on, whether a specific citation in it exists, or wants to check a reference before reusing it. Paged.

tools.name: edges_about
tools.description: Every edge touching the given work in either direction, each tagged asserted|inferred with attribution and provenance. Use when a user asks 'what is known about this paper's citations' or wants the whole neighbourhood in one call. Paged.

tools.name: retraction_listing
tools.description: Whether the Retraction Watch database lists the given DOI as retracted, from the dated export CiteStamp joins weekly. Use when a user asks whether a paper has been retracted or carries a retraction notice. Not listed means not in that export; the publisher record is not checked.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "what_supports" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
